# ines

41, Porto. Freelance translator, two children under seven, a partner who
leaves for work at seven. She runs four mornings a week before the house
wakes up, and the whole shape of her week follows from that one constraint.

Ten weeks of record, and the first thing to know about it is what it does not
have: a past. She installed vitai on the Monday she started, and every field
the schema offers existed on the day her first row was written.

## Why she exists

Every other persona in this corpus began before some mechanism did. Their
early rows are silent about things the schema could not yet express, so a null
in those rows means "the field did not exist yet" as often as it means "nobody
said" - and nothing in the record distinguishes the two.

Ines is the control. Her nulls are the real kind. When an engine output looks
wrong on a record with a long history, the corpus can now ask whether the
cause was the history or the code, by putting the same question to a record
that has no history to blame.

## What her week looks like

Runs Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday, always at ten past six, always
before anyone else is up. Sunday is the long one. One strength session on
Tuesday evening, kettlebell work in the front room after the children are
down.

She weighs on Monday and Thursday, fasted, before anything else, and wrote
the procedure down on the first line rather than leaving it to be inferred.
She logs food in an app all day and rates her mood in the evening.

## What she is trying to do

Four things, and she stated all four the week she started:

- stay under 2200 kcal on a weekday - a **ceiling**, per day
- at least 110 g of protein a day - a **floor**, per day, on the same axis
- settle at 62 kg and stay there - an **approach**, from either side, because
  she has been up and down this range for years and is not cutting
- keep 8000 steps a day - reached in week three, and held since

The last one is the interesting one. She marked it complete when she reached
it, and she is still meeting it, which is a different fact from having met it
once.

## What she is not

Not a beginner and not an athlete. She ran before the children and is running
again; the numbers are unremarkable on purpose, because a persona whose data
is dramatic tests the drama rather than the engine.

Entirely synthetic. Any resemblance to a real person is accidental and
unintended.
